1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 15 m de altura, de hojas grandes y flores entre blancas y lilas. (Melastomataceae; Miconia spp.).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching heights of up to 15 meters, with large leaves and flowers ranging in color from white to lilac. (Melastomataceae; Miconia spp.)
